questions.question: When Jesus rebuked an unclean spirit in the synagogue in Capernaum, what did He command it to do?

answers.text: Be silent and come out of him
Tell Me your name right now

questions.question: In the synagogue in Capernaum, a man with an unclean spirit cried out to Jesus. What did he call Jesus?
Early one morning while it was still dark, Jesus went out to a solitary place. What did He go there to do?
When Simon and his friends told Jesus that everyone was looking for Him, what did Jesus say they should do?

answers.text: Go on to the neighboring towns to preach
Go back to Capernaum to heal everyone
Stay in this quiet place to pray longer
